title: Roles & Permissions
description: Define access levels and manage permissions across your organization.

search.placeholder: Search roles by name or description...

r1.name: Administrator
r1.description: Full access to all system features, billing, and settings.

r2.name: Editor
r2.description: Can edit products and content, but cannot manage users.

r3.name: Support Agent
r3.description: Access to user sessions and basic troubleshooting tools.

r4.name: Viewer
r4.description: Read-only access to analytics and dashboards.

r5.name: API Developer
r5.description: Access to developer settings, API keys, and webhooks.
